test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

I trust him completely. His conduct is ________ suspicion.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given context, the word **"above**" is the most appropriate choice to complete the sentence.
 
• The phrase "**above suspicion**" means that someone's conduct is so good and trustworthy that they are not suspected of doing anything wrong.
 
• This is a commonly used expression to indicate a high level of trustworthiness and integrity.

Hence, the correct sentence is '*I trust him completely. His conduct is **above suspicion**.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase "**above suspicion**" is an** idiomatic expression** and should be used as is without altering its structure.
 
• It is important to choose words that fit the context and convey the intended meaning accurately.
